transcript.text: The plastic catch on my Hotpoint dryer door has snapped and now the door won't stay shut so it won't start. Model TVFM70BGP. Can I just get a new catch?

Please do not force the door open or shut, and never attempt to force or bypass the door lock. Open the door carefully and check that no clothing is caught in the seal. Once clear, shut it firmly until you hear a click, then press start. Does it still show the door as open?

Nothing's caught in the seal. The plastic tongue on the door has actually snapped off, so it can't click shut. The catch in the cabinet looks fine. Holding the door shut by hand makes it start, but I only tried that briefly. Do you know the part number for the door latch?

[Heading: Door latch / switch]
Thank you for checking the catch and strike; that helps narrow things down. Your findings point to an issue with the door interlock mechanism rather than the latch itself. I have identified the correct replacement part for your Hotpoint TVFM70BGP model below. Please ensure you unplug the dryer before attempting any fitting work yourself. If you prefer not to do this, a qualified appliance engineer can fit it for you.
